title: Project overview
description: Start with the README to see how BolKese tracks gold, FX, and cash, and how Docker versus local Vite/Express development works.

title: Frontend boot
description: main.jsx mounts App under StrictMode. App restores the session cookie then shows AuthScreen or the Portfolio workspace.

title: Session and API client
description: The shared request helper sends credentials: include. Auth helpers login and restore the user; requireAuth on the server verifies the HttpOnly JWT cookie.

title: Express entry and routes
description: backend/src/index.js mounts health, the altinapi proxy, and authenticated asset, lookup, and movement routers.

title: SQLite schema and seeds
description: schema.sql defines users, assets, movements, units, and symbols. db.js applies it and seedLookups fills units plus 66 altinapi symbols and TRY.

title: Holdings UI
description: AssetsPage lists the current user's holdings. Amount changes go through PATCH /api/assets/:id and logMovement writes a movement row.

title: Live prices
description: useMarketPrices polls /api/altin/prices every 45 seconds. MarketsPage groups quotes; bid is alış and ask is satış. TRY stays locked at 1.

title: Reports and movements
description: ReportsPage loads movement history and can export CSV. The backend lists owned movements with optional filters.

title: Packaging
description: docker-compose runs nginx on 8080 and Express. nginx routes /api/ to the backend; local Vite still proxies /api/altin first.
